source_ref: OSF dqw9f (public node; API reports no node licence): Supplemental Studies/Study S1c Data and Code/Study S1c Data.sav (https://osf.io/download/2knxu/, sha256 4a5debaf...d9142e) and Supplemental Studies/Study S2c Data and Code/Study S2c Data.sav (https://osf.io/download/6501f901f3dcd16832ddd406/, sha256 77e72d25...e4732e) -- SPSS variable and value labels of concern1-5; data/wallace_2026_mindsets.py for the code derivation and the S2c recode. Paper: Wallace, Murphy, Hernandez-Colmenares & Fujita (2026) JPSP 130(2) 291-307, doi:10.1037/pspi0000498.
note: Level 1, both label levels read (.sav sha256s match the batch_644/647 records). Code derivation: item IS the source column name (concern1-5 in both S1c and S2c; script maps concern{i}->concern{i}), so exempt from Step 5b and no verification files. PER-STUDY VARIANTS: live cov_study 4 = S1c (796 ids), 7 = S2c (793 ids). concern1's label is character-identical in both files and ships unprefixed; concern2-5 differ (S1c: 'in front of your boss' / 'your boss might ...'; S2c: 'in front of others' / 'other volunteers might ...'), so following the batch_644-648 convention their item_text carries both verbatim labels prefixed 'Study S1c (cov_study = 4): ' / 'Study S2c (cov_study = 7): ' joined by ' | ' (prefixes and separator are IRW's; wording after each prefix is the variable label verbatim). OPTIONS: S1c value labels 1='1 - not at all' ... 7='7 - very much'; S2c's run the other way (1='1 - very much' ... 7='7 - not at all') and the script rewrote S2c as 8-resp (itemcov_recoded=1 on all 3965 S2c rows, 0 on all 3980 S1c rows). Route 9: all 10 study x item count vectors match, e.g. S1c concern1 86/141/159/118/124/102/66 source = live; S2c concern1 source 62/74/158/118/150/129/102 -> live 102/129/150/118/158/74/62 (exact reversal); S2c concern4 source 53/54/100/140/137/141/168 -> live 168/141/137/140/100/54/53. Direction cross-check on the raw files: concern-mean correlates -0.50 (S1c) and -0.49 (S2c) with raw belong1-3,5 (whose S2c printed direction batch_645 confirmed), and the fixed-mindset condition shows more concern in both studies (S1c raw 4.23 fixed vs 3.34 growth on 1 = not at all; S2c raw 4.10 vs 4.85 on 1 = very much), so S2c's printed labels are correct and the recode is right. So live resp 1 = not at all, 7 = very much in both studies; option_text ships those anchors with the '1 - '/'7 - ' prefixes stripped (they would be wrong for the recoded S2c rows); resp 2-6 carry only their own digit in both sources and are left blank. No instructions text in either .sav or .sps; left blank. Rights: study-authored items, no stated restriction located (silence = permission).
public_note: Items concern2-5 were worded differently in the two pooled studies (about your boss in Study S1c, cov_study = 4; about others/other volunteers in Study S2c, cov_study = 7), so item_text gives both wordings labelled by study; responses are coded 1 = not at all to 7 = very much in both studies, Study S2c having been reverse-recoded from its printed order (itemcov_recoded = 1).
